title.narrative: Environmental Resilience in the Brazilian Amazon (State of Acre) - Outcome A

description.narrative: ID-00141137 - The Environmental Protection Areas (APAs) of Igarapé São Francisco and Lago do Amapá, in the state of Acre, located in the city of Rio Branco, face significant challenges related to socio-environmental vulnerability. These challenges result from the interaction between deforestation, water crises, river flooding periods, predatory economic activities, and climate change. Furthermore, expanding community participation in the management of these areas, adopting sustainable production practices, and promoting sustainable resource management projects are essential to reducing environmental degradation and improving resilience in the face of socio-environmental crises.
